sn35.2:1.1: Cakkhum bhikkhave dukkhaṃ || yaṃ dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Sotaṃ dukkhaṃ || || Ghānam dukkhaṃ || || Jivhā dukkhaṃ || || Kāyo dukkho || Mano dukkho || yam dukkhaṃ tad anattā || yad anattā taṃ Netam mama neso ham asmi na meso attāti Evam etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ || || Evam passaṃ ||pe|| nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
